method: Actual keyboard input and CharacterController in existing Melati; isolated synthetic devices ignore desktop focus; fixed 1/30 simulation delta. No hardware FPS claim.
checks: PASS Runtime controller, input configuration and non-modal world are ready
PASS Injected keyboard is enabled and current
PASS Standing avatar feet meet the actual road surface without moving the capsule
PASS Walking reaches the original speed cap
PASS Normal crouch mesh fits its actual capsule headroom and road surface
PASS Every sampled normal crouch stride stays on the road and inside capsule headroom
PASS Crouch release restores the existing standing capsule
PASS Existing walk/run/crouch speed caps retained
PASS Atmaja low capsule has a matching crouch mesh, floor and eye height
PASS Low Atmaja movement uses its authored deep crouch clip
PASS Baked low-crouch stride stays on the floor and below capsule headroom
PASS Low crouch keeps the held phone below capsule headroom and feet on the floor
PASS Phone reaches its held pose and keeps the camera feed
PASS World handset is visible once the authored grasp has settled
PASS Shoulder framing and phone share the physical aim line
PASS First-person still uses the player's eyes
PASS First-person displays the authored Raka hand
PASS First-person sleeve enters from the lower right and leaves the sightline clear
PASS Reading preserves the held phone and live feed
PASS Phone lowers completely without retaining input focus
PASS Actual walk input accelerates below the speed cap
PASS Walking reaches the original speed cap
PASS Running reaches the original speed cap
PASS Run braking settles within nine simulation frames
PASS Crouch movement uses the existing low capsule and speed
PASS Checkpoint save/load remains available after presentation changes
